limitations.text:
⚠️
Proxy target: late delivery • DataCo public data • not Indian COD.
Limitations & Governance
Constraints, dataset context and ethical guidelines (see MODEL_CARD.md).
1. The proxy-target reality

Late_delivery_risk is an upstream fulfilment proxy, NOT Return-To-Origin (RTO).

In Indian D2C e-commerce, RTO occurs when a buyer refuses delivery, cancels at the doorstep or commits COD fraud.
In the DataCo dataset the label reflects whether delivery duration exceeded the contracted carrier SLA.
Delays can raise doorstep-refusal propensity, but this model predicts delay, not refusal.
2. Near rule-based label construction
Same Day orders placed from 12:00 are late 95.4% of the time vs 0.0% before noon (3,571 Same Day orders).
The top decile of scores is 100.00% First Class orders.
100.0% precision in the top decile is an artefact of the near rule-based labels, not model insight.
3. Payment type is a label artifact

All 2,855 CANCELED / SUSPECTED_FRAUD orders are TRANSFER payments (15.8% of TRANSFER orders vs 0.0% of other types) and every one is labelled on time (late rate 0.0% / 0.0% vs 57.3% for other statuses). Controlling for shipping mode, the TRANSFER late-rate difference is -9.1 pp, and +0.0 pp once those orders are removed. TRANSFER is not a real payment-risk signal.

4. Standard and Second Class blind spot

Standard Class (59.7%) and Second Class (19.5%) together are 79.2% of test volume. ROC-AUC is 0.5292 for Standard Class (95% CI 0.514 to 0.544) and 0.5666 for Second Class (0.535 to 0.597), and 38.0% of Standard Class orders share one calibrated score. Checkout-time signals cannot predict unobservable middle- and last-mile carrier delays.

5. Geographic scope & public-data constraints
DataCo comes from Western cross-border retail (North America, LATAM, Europe).
It does not capture PIN-code delivery tiers, NDR/IVR confirmation or doorstep COD refusal.
Do not deploy without retraining on real courier and return telemetry.
6. Advisory governance & ethical guardrails
Human in the loop: decision support only; never autonomous order cancellation or payment decline.
Fairness: monitor regional and customer-history late rates so they do not compound regional delivery disadvantages.
